_about: Every earthwork truth case tests/test_earthwork_regress.py replays. One entry per case; add a DEM-derived truth sheet by adding an entry, not by editing the test. Fields: id; sheet (human name, engine page index AND printed sheet); kind = how the inputs are read (fixture: one committed JSON like earthwork_oncor_c04_inputs.json; seed_flips: the offline-recipe folder layout under out/verify with seed/result/flips/boundary files); source = where the row set and its verification live; baseline = the exact-float expectation file, committed under tests/baselines/ ONLY for non-client data - client work keeps it gitignored beside its inputs; runs = the cut_fill configurations (boundary: recipe | shrunk75 | null; surface_model; cell_ft; existing_offset_ft / proposed_offset_ft; spots = N proposed spot points). Gitignored inputs that are absent print SKIPPED and are counted, never silently passed.
